jobs.title: Adviseur software development en automatisering
jobs.description:
Waar code en engineering samenkomen

Technische installaties leveren steeds meer data op. Maar hoe zet je die data om in software waar engineers en assetbeheerders echt mee kunnen werken? Als AI Software Engineer bij Iv bouw je toepassingen die precies dat doen.

Van AI voor inspecties tot risico gestuurd assetmanagement: jouw software helpt om technische assets slimmer te beheren. Je ontwikkelt schaalbare applicaties en API’s met onder andere Python, C# en FastAPI. Daarbij vertaal je technische vraagstukken naar oplossingen die betrouwbaar werken en praktisch toepasbaar zijn.

Een goed idee is pas waardevol als het ook in de praktijk werkt. Daarom denk je mee over de software-architectuur, werk je technische ontwerpen uit en bouw je mee aan de implementatie. Je doorloopt het hele ontwikkelproces en blijft betrokken bij de doorontwikkeling. Zo ontstaan maakbare oplossingen voor infrastructuur, offshore platforms, waterzuiveringen en industriële installaties.

Ook AI krijgt daarin steeds meer ruimte. Denk aan toepassingen die inspectie- en sensordata analyseren of AI-chatbots die engineers ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken. Samen met data-analisten, data scientists, software developers en inhoudelijke engineers bepaal je wat technisch nodig én bruikbaar is. Het resultaat: software dat aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk van onze klanten.

Je komt terecht binnen de sector Assetmanagement en werkt nauw samen met collega’s van ICT en Digitalisering. Hier houden we van ingewikkelde technische vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de sfeer is ontspannen en professioneel en we zoeken samen naar een oplossing die werkt. Tegelijk krijg je ruimte om jouw rol verder vorm te geven. Wil je dieper de AI in, meer richting architectuur of juist technische verantwoordelijkheid pakken? Jouw ambitie en talent bepalen mede waar je naartoe groeit.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.
3 tot 5 jaar werkervaring als software engineer, AI engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring met Python en bij voorkeur ook C#.
Kennis van SQL, API-ontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld met FastAPI, en moderne software-architecturen.
Interesse in of ervaring met AI, machine learning en datagedreven toepassingen.
Ervaring met Azure of een ander cloudplatform is een pré.
Affiniteit met assetmanagement, infrastructuur of industriële toepassingen.
Je werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het volledige ontwikkelproces.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op:

De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Van ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten.
Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer!
Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide!
Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding.
Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden talloze mogelijkheden tot het volgen van opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen om nóg beter te worden in je vak.

Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

About The Company

advasolutions SE is a leading provider of innovative software and automation solutions tailored for the intralogistics industry. Our core focus is on developing modular shuttle systems that seamlessly integrate hardware, control systems, and software into scalable, comprehensive solutions for automated warehouse and material flow processes. We are committed to advancing intralogistics through cutting-edge technology, enabling our clients to optimize their logistics operations with efficiency and reliability.

Our software development teams work extensively with modern technologies such as .NET/C#, microservices architecture, messaging frameworks, actor models like Microsoft Orleans, containerization with Docker, and orchestration via Kubernetes. We develop distributed systems that directly interface with our proprietary hardware and real-world logistics processes. Beyond backend and platform development, our scope includes frontend interfaces, DevOps practices, computer vision applications, and system integrations. At advasolutions SE, we foster a collaborative environment where developers work closely with engineering, product development, and project teams, witnessing firsthand how their solutions operate within actual logistics systems.

Our approach emphasizes comprehensive involvement from technical decisions to architecture evolution, ensuring that every solution is practical, scalable, and aligned with customer needs. We believe in continuous innovation and active team participation, making advasolutions SE a dynamic place for software engineers passionate about logistics and automation technology.

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable microservices that underpin our warehouse and shuttle systems. Your responsibilities will include contributing to the evolution of our internal frameworks for messaging, logging, eventing, and service communication, ensuring our platform remains robust and adaptable to future needs.

The role involves translating customer requirements into tailored automation solutions, from initial analysis and solution design to implementation and deployment. You will work on designing and implementing architectures, interfaces, and integrations with various software and automation components, ensuring seamless communication and operation across different systems. Additionally, you will participate in software testing, system stabilization, and support during go-live phases, providing critical contributions to project success.

As part of your responsibilities, you will conduct code reviews, uphold quality standards, and develop reusable solutions that can be integrated into our standard software platform. Mentoring junior developers and collaborating closely with product owners, QA teams, and other technical teams will be essential to facilitate knowledge sharing and project cohesion. Active engagement in DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and automation tools like GitHub Actions, Nuke, Docker, and SonarCloud, will be expected to ensure efficient deployment cycles and high-quality software releases.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on innovative logistics automation projects, influence system architecture, and contribute to the development of industry-leading solutions in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess several years of professional experience in software development with a strong focus on C# and .NET technologies. A solid background in developing microservices and distributed systems is essential, along with experience in designing software architectures, interfaces, and technical solutions. Proven expertise in implementing software in customer projects, coupled with a secure handling of version control systems like Git, is required.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes is highly desirable. Candidates should have a good understanding of REST APIs, distributed service communication, and integration techniques. Knowledge of clean code principles, software quality assurance, and maintainable architecture design is critical. Strong decision-making skills, clear communication, and the ability to work collaboratively within a team are vital for success.

Excellent verbal and written proficiency in both German and English (minimum C1 level) is mandatory. Willingness to travel for project-related activities, including integration, commissioning, and go-live support (approximately 15% travel), is also required. While familiarity with all technologies in our stack is not mandatory, a strong foundation in .NET, distributed systems, and software architecture, along with enthusiasm to learn new technologies, is essential.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the ongoing development of scalable and high-performance microservices in C#/.NET, utilizing Microsoft Orleans for backend operations within our warehouse and shuttle systems. Your role includes shaping and enhancing our internal frameworks that support messaging, logging, eventing, and service communication, ensuring they meet evolving project needs.

Implementing customer-specific requirements for warehouse automation projects is a core aspect of your work, covering analysis, solution design, and implementation phases. You will design and develop system architectures, interfaces, and integrations with various software and automation components, ensuring interoperability and robustness.

Quality assurance through software, integration, and system testing, as well as supporting deployment, stabilization, and go-live activities at customer sites, will be part of your responsibilities. Conducting code reviews, maintaining high coding standards, and translating project solutions into reusable components for our standard platform are key tasks.

Mentoring junior developers and working closely with product owners, QA teams, and other technical units such as Shuttle, Stations, and IT teams will be crucial for project success. You will also actively participate in DevOps and CI/CD processes, leveraging tools like GitHub Actions, Nuke, Docker, and SonarCloud to streamline development and deployment workflows.

Make excellent engineering the easy path, for every squad at If CTP

If is the biggest insurance company in the Nordics: thousands of skilled colleagues keeping everyday life running for millions of customers, their homes, cars, businesses and more. Behind that promise stands modern engineering, and behind our engineers stands Engineering Excellence: a DevOps-oriented enablement team whose product is the capability of every other squad. We are now looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to build shared platforms, coach fellow engineers, and shape safe, human-approved agentic AI ways of working.

About The Role

This is not a feature-delivery seat, it is a multiplier role. Instead of shipping one product, you make many squads better at shipping theirs, and your definition of done includes adoption: work is finished when another team can use, own and support it.

Day To Day, You Will

Build and evolve our shared engineering backbone: reusable CI/CD pipelines and pipeline libraries, repository practices, platform tooling, integrations and automation on Azure and Azure DevOps.
Establish and enable engineering standards, guardrails, and branching and naming conventions that make the right way the easy way.
Strengthen quality and security: validation and testing enablement, software scanning, secure-engineering practice, reliability, and actionable engineering feedback.
Untangle material cross-squad blockers in builds, environments, delivery and platform, making dependencies visible and handing over responsibly.
Coach engineers and squads, support onboarding, and turn hard-won knowledge into documentation people actually use.
Use engineering metrics, discovery and evidence to guide continuous improvement, without overstating what the data proves.

You will also be hands-on in our agentic engineering journey. We are building an AI-assisted operating model for the team that starts deliberately read-only and follows a strict loop: agents observe and propose, humans approve, and only then are changes applied. You will help design these proposal-controlled workflows, the guardrails and least-privilege access behind them, and the evidence that shows what AI adoption genuinely improves.

You will work across every squad rather than inside one, side by side with architects, squad technical leads, Product Management and program stakeholders. It is a rare vantage point that grows your platform depth and your influence at the same time. The team runs on Kanban flow rather than sprints: demand is clarified, work is made ready, delivered, validated, documented and handed over, with blockers made visible instead of hidden.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

About The Team
